subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should the Android message action surface in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100879 be accepted with Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply, or narrowed before landing?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested behavior, but the open maintainer-authored PR now owns the concrete scope and should not be bypassed by a new automated fix PR.

options.title: Land the linked action surface
options.body: Accept the Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply scope after PR review and Android proof, then let the PR close this issue on merge.

options.title: Narrow before landing
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask the PR to limit scope to Copy and Select text if Share or Reply should not be part of the first Android action menu.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the issue open as product backlog, or close with a maintainer decision if Android message actions are not planned now.

recommendation.title: Land the linked action surface
recommendation.body: Accept the Copy, Select text, Share, and Reply scope after PR review and Android proof, then let the PR close this issue on merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the issue, owns the linked same-scope PR, and has recent history on the affected Android chat files.
